title: Tabs
description: Tab bar + panel router built on svelte-super. Use with the exported Tab (SuperContent) children: each Tab needs an id and optional opened flag. The children snippet of Tabs receives { select, open, close, toggle, isActive, controls }.

children.description: Snippet that receives tab control helpers and should render Tab panels.

Tab.description: Panel primitive (svelte-super SuperContent). Props: id (string, tab label/key), opened (boolean, initially active).

params.name: id
params.description: Tab identifier shown in the tab bar.

params.name: opened
params.description: When true, this tab is selected on first render.
